stories.title: Shia protests erupt over the assassination of Iran's supreme leader
stories.summary: Shia communities in South Asia erupted in anger as news emerged of the assassination of the Iranian supreme leader Ayatollah Ali Khamenei.

stories.title: A new single-pill treatment for HIV shows promising results
stories.summary: A new single-pill treatment for HIV has shown promising results. This is particularly useful for people who have had HIV for decades.

stories.title: The Trump administration's objectives for the mission in Iran
stories.summary: President Trump said the ongoing strikes on Iran are the best chance to strike at its nuclear weapons program. But that's the same program he said, not long ago, was completely obliterated.

stories.title: This woman is providing second-hand clothes that teens don't just need, but want
stories.summary: Donated clothes for low-income kids aren't always that cool. So a volunteer at a school district in Sonoma County curates, launders and presents clothing donations that teens actually want to wear.

stories.title: Texas Senate candidates' final push ahead of Tuesday primaries
stories.summary: The Republican primary in the Texas Senate race is turning out to be one of the most closely watched races in the country. Its results could have consequences for Republican control of the Senate.

stories.title: If you change the colors of a concert hall, you may change how patrons hear music
stories.summary: Does the color of a concert venue change how we hear music? German researchers have an answer.
